packageRules.description: merge policy (§8.5): Renovate-side automerge is off at the repository level — a Renovate PR merges when its hosted checks are green AND the platform approval gate passes (the default-branch ruleset's pull_request rule requires a code-owner review); Renovate PRs get no bypass. The required_status_checks ruleset shape (empty, strict) reads ALL status checks on the PR, so no partial-green merge path exists. Major-version flake input bumps are suppressed — they ride the release-cycle review, not the monthly batch.

nixpkgs + every other flake input: one monthly batched PR (the nix manager covers the whole lock: nixpkgs included); the first-Monday 06:00-09:59 Melbourne window in the top-level schedule governs the repo
